how_to_read.line: Product lines kept apart from the crypto allocation layer: each has its own benchmark and none competes for the core's weight.
how_to_read.opens: The forward record starts on this date. Earlier numbers anywhere else are replay, not evidence.
how_to_read.excess_vs_benchmark: Total return minus the named benchmark's over the same window (world50: momentum tilt vs equal weight; alt leaders: each picker vs every name in the gate; the gate vs the crypto core).
how_to_read.also_same_window: Other references over the same window, returns only (ETH, the crypto core, the World50 book).

rows.note: 空跑:只记意图,没有成交,滑点不适用
only 2 intents — too few to price the spread; keep logging.

execution.how_to_read: One row per execution sleeve, cumulative since its first intent. Sleeves ending in _dry record intents only (no orders), so slippage is blank there, not zero. For live sleeves: mean_slippage_bps is the fill price against the mid at decision time (positive = paid), mean_fee_bps the venue fee on filled notional, mean_opportunity_bps what unfilled orders cost, implementation_shortfall_bps their sum. median_quoted_spread_bps is the spread at decision time, i.e. what a backtest assumes and never observes. n_unresolved counts intents with no recorded outcome; that is a data gap, not a trade that did not happen. Small n means a thin estimate, not a good one.

how_to_read.window: The allocation layer's forward window: from 2026-10-02 (or the book's first day, whichever is later). Earlier history is not shown here - some of it is after-the-fact replay, not evidence.
how_to_read.excess_vs_core: Book total return minus the core's (24 names, market-cap weighted, spot only; single coin capped at 40% until 2026-10-12, uncapped since) over the same window. The benchmark is always holding the core, never zero.
how_to_read.anytime_lower_bound_ann: Anytime-valid lower bound on the mean daily excess, annualised: re-checking it daily does not inflate it. The allocation layer admits a book on either of two paths: forward - this bound is > 0 with at least 20 forward days (the minimum to estimate a variance, not a waiting period); or simulated - a point-in-time replay whose sealed holdout (never used to tune the rule) ranks at or above the 95th percentile of 1,000 random timings with a positive anytime lower bound, unless forward evidence then turns significantly negative. Weights are shrunk toward 0 first.
how_to_read.evidence_class: forward | forward_young (< 20 forward days, descriptive only) | caveat (known issue, numbers not reliable) | retired | frozen (no new rows since the freeze date; the record is kept) | no_record (could not be read - not a zero).
how_to_read.l3_weight: Weight the allocation layer gave this book on its latest day; the core takes the rest.

note: Paper records, not live-traded P&L, except the lines marked live under other_lines (the real-money account, marked daily and anchored) and the execution section (real fills against the decision mid). Every number is labelled with its evidence class; no book is pre-judged here.
compliance: Positioning language only; not investment advice.
